pages.title: Juniper & Shears
pages.description: An unhurried Ottawa hair salon for thoughtful cuts, dimensional colour and everyday styling. Find us in Old Ottawa South.

sections.heading: A fresh cut. A little time for yourself.
sections.text: Settle into our welcoming neighbourhood salon. We listen to your routine, talk through your ideas and shape a look that feels like you.

image.alt: A bright salon with styling chairs and mirrors

sections.heading: A quieter kind of salon
sections.text: Founded by stylist Amélie Roy in 2019, Juniper & Shears makes room for a real consultation. Ask for a quiet appointment if you prefer less conversation. Our entrance is step-free, and we welcome questions about access before your visit.

images.alt: Comfortable styling stations in a light-filled salon
Salon workspace prepared for a hair appointment

items.quote: Amélie asked about my morning routine and gave me a cut I can style in five minutes. Such a calm, welcoming space.
items.author: Nora T.

sections.heading: Ready for your next appointment?
sections.text: Call or email with your preferred stylist, service and a few dates that work for you. We will reply during opening hours.

pages.title: Services
pages.description: Haircuts, colour and styling at Juniper & Shears in Ottawa. Transparent starting prices and consultations for every colour appointment.

sections.heading: Your hair, your style
sections.text: Our pricing follows the service and time required, rather than gender. All prices are in Canadian dollars, before HST.

items.name: Cut and finish
items.description: Consultation, wash, precision cut and styling. Allow 60 minutes.

items.name: Clipper cut
items.description: A tailored short cut with clippers and finishing work. Allow 30 minutes.

items.name: Root colour
items.description: Colour touch-up with a wash and finish. A consultation confirms the final price.

items.name: Partial highlights
items.description: Face-framing dimension, toner and a finish. Extra product or time is quoted before we start.

items.question: Do I need a colour consultation?
items.answer: New colour guests receive a complimentary 15-minute consultation before booking. We discuss your goals, maintenance and any required patch test.

items.question: What is your cancellation policy?
items.answer: Please give at least 24 hours' notice if you need to change your appointment. Late cancellations may incur a fee of 50% of the booked service.

items.question: Can I ask for a quiet appointment?
items.answer: Absolutely. Mention it when booking and we will keep conversation to the consultation and anything needed for your comfort.

pages.title: Team and booking
pages.description: Meet Amélie and Devin, the stylists at Juniper & Shears, and book your Ottawa salon appointment by phone or email.

items.name: Amélie Roy
items.bio: Amélie loves lived-in colour and versatile cuts. She has spent twelve years helping guests find a style that fits their everyday life.

items.name: Devin Patel
items.bio: Devin specialises in textured cuts, short styles and careful finishing. Their appointments start with a conversation about how you want your hair to feel.

sections.heading: Book a little time for yourself
sections.text: Call or email to request an appointment. Please include your preferred service, stylist and availability. We are closed on Sundays and Mondays.
